# Dangerous Pretzel Co.

> Soft pretzel shop in Salt Lake City. Fresh retail at the Post District counter, plus wholesale flash-frozen foodservice.

Dangerous Pretzel Co. (https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/index.html) bakes soft pretzels at 352 W 600 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101. Wholesale pretzels are fully baked in that kitchen — not raw dough — then flash-frozen and vacuum-sealed. The site does not publish case packs, MOQs, or price lists for wholesale. Dangerous Pretzel Co. is listed in US Foods catalogs for Northern Utah and Boise. US Foods customers in those areas can order it through their US Foods rep. The site does not publish US Foods item codes or prices.

Canonical host is https://www.dangerouspretzel.com. https://dangerouspretzel.com 301s to www. Pretty paths such as `/menu` and `/catering-menu` 301 to the `/v2/*.html` URLs below. Those HTML files are the 200 documents. `/` 301s to `/v2/index.html`.

## Shop

- [Home](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/index.html): Hand-crafted soft pretzels. Pickup, catering, and wholesale links.
- [Menu](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/menu.html): Pretzels, bombs, house-made dips, and drinks.
- [Catering](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/catering.html): Pretzel catering in Salt Lake City. Boxes, bomb trays, and dips for offices, schools, and events. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or delivery in the SLC metro. Order form notice: Under $200: 12hr notice · $200–$500: 24hr notice · $500+: 48hr notice.
- [Wedding catering](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/wedding-pretzel-catering.html): Order wedding pretzel catering in Salt Lake City, including event venues. Cocktail hour, late-night snack, rehearsal dinners, and receptions. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75). Request form on the catering page. Shop counter Friday–Sunday 11am–8pm; catering requests for future dates any day, with 12, 24, or 48 hours notice depending on order size.
- [Office and corporate catering](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/office-pretzel-catering.html): Order office pretzel catering in Salt Lake City. Pretzel boxes (15 per box), bomb trays (100 pretzel bombs per tray, 4–6 per serving, feeds 16–25), and dips for one meeting, team event, office party, or client event. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75). Request form on the catering page. Notice: Under $200: 12hr notice · $200–$500: 24hr notice · $500+: 48hr notice. Not a standing wholesale account.
- [Game-day catering](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/game-day-pretzel-catering.html): Order game-day pretzel catering in Salt Lake City. Watch parties, tailgates, team parties, and Jazz, Utes, or Real Salt Lake-style game nights at homes and offices in Salt Lake City. Pretzel boxes, bomb trays, and dips. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75). Request form on the catering page. Notice: Under $200: 12hr notice · $200–$500: 24hr notice · $500+: 48hr notice.
- [Holiday party catering](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/holiday-party-pretzel-catering.html): Order holiday party pretzel catering in Salt Lake City. Holiday parties, company and office holiday parties, end-of-year team events, and family gatherings in Salt Lake City. Pretzel boxes, bomb trays, and dips. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75). Request form on the catering page. Notice: Under $200: 12hr notice · $200–$500: 24hr notice · $500+: 48hr notice. Send December dates when the party is on the calendar. The published notice is the one on the catering page.
- [Party catering](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/party-pretzel-catering.html): Order party pretzel catering in Salt Lake City. Birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers, graduations, and similar private parties in Salt Lake City. Pretzel boxes, bomb trays, and dips. Pickup at 352 W 600 S, or SLC metro delivery ($75). Request form on the catering page. Notice is 12, 24, or 48 hours depending on order size. The catering page lists which notice applies.
- [Location](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/location.html): 352 W 600 S, Post District. Friday–Sunday 11am–8pm. Closed Monday–Thursday. Shop contact, and the kitchen that bakes SLC metro wholesale. Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A is a wholesale account on the same published list as the Goldminer’s Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, and Fisher Brewing — not the shop counter and not catering.
- [FAQ](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/faq.html): Hours, catering notice, wholesale, and dietary notes.

## Wholesale

- [Soft pretzel wholesale](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/wholesale.html): Wholesale soft pretzels for Utah foodservice, on US Foods in Northern Utah and Boise. Request a sample drop-off from the Salt Lake City bakery. Flash-frozen for restaurants, bars, offices, grocery, and venues.
- [Restaurants and bars](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-restaurants.html): Menu pretzel, back-of-house reheat. Not a raw-dough kit.
- [Bars and breweries](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-bars.html): Taproom bombs and menu twists. No bakery staff.
- [Grocery and retail](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-grocery.html): 3-day fresh retail shelf or flash-frozen hold.
- [Event venues](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-venues.html): Concessions wholesale. Frozen cases to reheat, not the Pretzel Program station.
- [Ski resorts](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-ski-resorts.html): Wholesale soft pretzels for ski resort concessions. Already serves the Goldminer's Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A, and Fisher Brewing. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples.
- [Family entertainment](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-family-entertainment.html): Wholesale soft pretzels for arcades, bowling alleys, roller rinks, trampoline parks, and family entertainment centers in Utah. Already serves the Goldminer's Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A, and Fisher Brewing — that list is not a map of arcades or bowling alleys. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples.
- [Ice rinks and arenas](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-ice-rinks-arenas.html): Wholesale soft pretzels for ice rinks, ice rink snack bars, speed-skating ovals, arenas, sports complexes, and rec-center concessions in Utah and Boise. A hot, easy-to-hold snack between periods or sessions. Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A is on the account list, with the Goldminer's Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, and Fisher Brewing. That list is not a map of every rink. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Request a sample drop-off on the wholesale inquiry. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples.
- [Movie theaters](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-movie-theaters.html): Wholesale soft pretzels for movie theater and cinema concession stands in Utah and Boise. A hot, easy-to-hold snack for a captive crowd that pairs with concessions. The published accounts (Goldminer's Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A, Fisher Brewing) are not a list of theaters. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Request a sample drop-off on the wholesale inquiry. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples.
- [Recreation centers](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-recreation-centers.html): Wholesale soft pretzels for city recreation centers, rec snack bars, and municipal concessions in Utah. For rec center and municipal concession managers, including when a city issues a vendor RFP or keeps an approved vendor list. No recreation center or city is named as a customer. The published accounts (Goldminer's Daughter at Alta, Brighton, Powder Mountain, Delta Center (Levy) Level 5A, Fisher Brewing) are not a list of recreation centers or cities. US Foods customers in Northern Utah and Boise can order through their US Foods rep. Request a sample drop-off on the wholesale inquiry. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples.
- [Frozen foodservice](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/frozen-soft-pretzels.html): Fully baked, then flash-frozen. Fresh retail hold is described separately.
- [Utah / Salt Lake](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-utah.html): Wholesale soft pretzels for Utah and Salt Lake City foodservice, baked at 352 W 600 S. SLC metro van; freight for the rest of Utah. On US Foods in Northern Utah and Boise. Request a sample drop-off. Walk-in retail is a separate account.
- [Intermountain](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-intermountain.html): SLC metro van; freight for the region. Mountain West is a listed distributor region.
- [Distributor vs direct](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/distributor-vs-direct-wholesale.html): Stock one business, or carry the brand in a region.
- [Become a distributor](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/distributor.html): Inquire to carry Dangerous Pretzel in a region. Stocking one business is direct wholesale — two inquiry forms. Available through US Foods in Northern Utah and Boise. The page does not name any other distributor. Another distributor is named on the wholesale inquiry so the team can look into it.
- [Offices and campuses](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-offices.html): Standing orders, no kitchen build-out. Not catering.
- [How wholesale reheat works](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/how-wholesale-reheat-works.html): Partner onboarding. Fully baked, then flash-frozen. No published temps or times.
- [Become a wholesale customer](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/become-a-wholesale-customer.html): Start a wholesale soft pretzel account. Checklist that funnels to the inquiry form. How do I get samples? Request a sample drop-off on that form. Paul or Emery from the team can drop off samples. Who should contact Dangerous Pretzel / who handles food purchasing? The person who handles food purchasing for the business, with the business name, a contact name, and the city.
- [Wholesale vs mall pretzel](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-wholesale-vs-mall.html): Shop pretzel for foodservice. Fully baked in SLC, flash-frozen. Not a mall pretzel or a commodity case.
- [Catering vs wholesale](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/catering-vs-wholesale.html): One event is catering (boxes, trays, dips). Standing or on-demand cases is wholesale.
- [Add to a restaurant menu](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/add-soft-pretzels-to-restaurant-menu.html): Inquiry, assortment, reheat. Then it plates. No bakery staff.
- [Foodservice supplier](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/soft-pretzel-foodservice-supplier.html): SLC bakery that supplies flash-frozen pretzels to foodservice. Metro van or freight. National is a distributor application region, not a coverage map.
- [Pretzel bombs wholesale](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/pretzel-bombs-wholesale.html): Bite-size for concessions, taprooms, and grab-and-go. 5 bomb varieties in the published range. Not a catering tray.
- [Salt Lake restaurant wholesale](https://www.dangerouspretzel.com/v2/salt-lake-restaurant-pretzel-wholesale.html): Menu pretzel for SLC restaurants. Metro van from 352 W 600 S. Utah page is logistics; this page is the kitchen.
